hero_kpi_rationale: Key structural element reflecting the insurer's financial strength with a $101.18 billion portfolio generating returns to support loss reserves

kpis.name: Investment Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Fair value of total invested assets including fixed maturities, equities, and other securities
kpis.description: The investment portfolio is primarily composed of fixed-income securities (89% in debt securities) intended to fund loss reserves

kpis.name: Interest Rate Risk Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Estimated fair value loss from hypothetical 100 basis point increase in interest rates
kpis.description: Estimated loss of $3.68 billion in the event of a 100 basis point increase in interest rates, based on the model's sensitivity analysis

kpis.name: Foreign Currency Risk Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Estimated fair value loss from hypothetical 10% depreciation of foreign currency holdings
kpis.description: Estimated loss of $373 million in the event of a 10% depreciation of foreign currency-denominated investments, down due to reduced exposure to Canadian dollars

kpis.name: Investment Portfolio Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth rate of total invested assets
kpis.description: The 7.4% growth in the investment portfolio reflects a $6.96 billion increase, a key indicator of financial health and return generation

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report highlights significant exposure to interest rate risk, with a potential loss of $3.68 billion in the event of a 100 basis point increase in interest rates

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk

risks.title: Credit Risk

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the property and casualty insurance sector at both federal and state levels

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: As a sector leader for over 170 years, the company is sensitive to reputation and the trust of customers and business partners

risks.title: Operational Risk
